footer.note: Every indexed post was published by its company's team; the copyright stays with the original authors.
home.building.body: The crawler and the list pages are not ready yet. What works today is the i18n skeleton: both the Chinese and the English UI copy are wired up.
home.building.title: The site is a work in progress
home.intro: This site keeps only the title, summary, author, publish date and a link to the original post. Full posts are never republished.
meta.home.description: One index of engineering blog posts from Chinese internet companies, browsable by company, topic and year, with full-text search. Every card links to the original post.
meta.home.title: Engineering blogs from Chinese tech teams
